description: Look up traditional colors by name and get hex/RGB with sources. Accepts Japanese kanji (浅葱色), reading in hiragana or katakana (あさぎいろ), English (Asagi, Prussian Blue), with or without 色. Exact name matches come first.

culture.description: Culture id from list_cultures (e.g. japanese, chinese, western) or its name.

name: find_color
title: Find a color by name
